subject: Request to make good lapsed trial credits — Spotlight AI evaluation
messages:
From: Elisa Morales <elisa@spotlight.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits expired — request to reinstate for final evaluation

Hi Camila,

Hope you're well. We were in the middle of a final integration pass when our trial credits expired last week, which paused our performance validation. We ran ~22k tokens of end-to-end tests in the last 7 days — attached is a quick usage snapshot.

Can you make a one-off reinstate of credits so we can finish performance benchmarks? Ideally we need either 30 days or ~60k tokens to complete the remaining tests. If helpful, Spotlight is prepared to confirm a PO or sign the MPA within two weeks.

Happy to jump on a short call to align.

Thanks,
Elisa Morales
Senior ML Eng, Spotlight AI
Elisa Morales
Elisa@spotlight.ai
Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 28KB)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request to reinstate for final evaluation

Hi Elisa — thanks for the note and the snapshot. Sorry for the interruption; I'll loop in Sales Ops and Finance to review a one-time make-good.

Quick questions to speed this up:
- Account ID or HubSpot company link (if different from the one you included)
- Is there a signed MPA in process or a PO to expect?
- Are you able to update a payment method in the portal if we provide a temporary top-up?

I'll propose an approval path and follow up inside 24–48 hrs. If you can share the HubSpot link or PO number now that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Team — forwarding Elisa's request. Spotlight AI (HubSpot link below) lost trial credits mid-eval and asks for a temporary top-up to finish final benchmarks. Attached usage snapshot shows steady activity and a clear finish line.

Proposal for one-time exception:
- Grant up to 45k tokens (sufficient for their remaining tests)
- 30-day extension window (non-rolling)
- Conditional on either: signed MPA or an updated payment method + PO within 14 days
- Offer 25% credit (discount) on first month if they convert within 30 days after extension

Requesting:
- Ben: OK from commercial? Do we want to tie to a conversion trigger?
- Lauren: Sales Ops — any billing restrictions or tasks to create a temporary invoice?
- Priyom: Finance — approval on token amount and whether we need a formal MPA signature before we top up.

Attachments: usage_snapshot.csv, draft-mpa.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Spotlight-AI

Thanks — Camila

Camila / team,

Finance is OK to approve a limited make-good under the following conditions:
- Limit to 45,000 tokens max
- Credit valid for 30 calendar days from issuance

- Add a note in HubSpot and tag as "one-time-credit" for audit

Priyom Das

Redwood Inference

Hi Elisa — quick update and good news. Finance approved a one-time grant of 45,000 tokens valid for 30 days. This is conditional on either: (1) a signed MPA within 14 days or (2) an updated payment method + PO on file within 14 days. If neither condition is met we will rescind the credit and any usage will be invoiced.

Next steps to accept the credit:
1) Please review and sign the attached MPA (draft attached) or upload a PO to the billing portal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Spotlight-AI
2) We will provision the 45k token credit within 1 business day of receiving the signed MPA or PO + payment method confirmation
3) If you sign/confirm conversion within 30 days after activation, we'll apply a 25% credit to the first month of committed usage as discussed.

DocuSign link (for convenience): https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123
Attachment: draft-mpa.docx

Please reply here when you've uploaded the PO or signed the MPA and we'll process immediately. Happy to set a 15-min call if you'd like to review the terms.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
cc: Ben Carter (Commercial), Priyom Das (Finance), Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops)
